summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Inc. filed an 8-K on October 2, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that Torchlight Loan Services, LLC became special servicer for the Colorado Center mortgage loan and related pari passu and subordinate notes, a non-serviced loan combination governed by the BXP 2017-CC trust and servicing agreement. Torchlight replaces Argentic Services Company LP, appointed at the direction of Aperture Strategic Credit Master Fund, LP, the directing certificateholder. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or closing condition is stated; servicing continues under the existing BXP 2017-CC TSA. Watch for any future special-servicing transfer as a credit signal.
